text:
megan: Heads up — telemetry picked up ~20% failed project attribution since we flipped the routing-sampler canary this morning. Likely auth header exchange mismatch between proxy and authz service.

devon: On it. Can you paste an example trace or headers?

megan: Example from a failed request:
`Authorization: ApiKey org=org_123 project=proj-x token=sk_...`
`X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4`
Proxy rewrites into: `X-Org: org_123` and `X-Project: proj-123` but authz expects `proj_id` claim.

akira: This smells like canonicalization: router normalizes project -> proj_id in the SVID path, so when proxy writes X-Project we don't map it back to the token binder. If sampler drops origin, attribution loses the project binding.

sam: We changed the sampler priority to prefer key-affinity over origin to reduce noise during the scale test. That explains why origin headers are being deprioritized. If origin header gets dropped in the sampler step, attribution fails.

megan: Can we flip the sampler order in non-prod and run the canary again? I can stage the patch and monitor.

devon: Yes — runtime flag is `routing.sampler.priority=origin,affinity`. I'll open a quick change and push a canary to infra-canary-2.

infra-bot: deploy started: routing-sampler-v2 -> infra-canary-2 (deployer=devon) :rocket:

megan: Also UX note: console shows "Unknown project" for affected traces with no hint. Can we show a short tooltip "missing project header — check proxy canonicalization" so support sees cause quickly?

akira: Edge case: service accounts minted cross-org (ci-sa) still present org claim in token. Attribution should prefer token's org/project claims when present, fallback to headers. Sam — can you make that explicit in the sampler logic?

sam: Yep. Plan: 1) change priority to origin,affinity in canary; 2) add explicit token-claim first rule for service accounts; 3) emit metric `attribution_missing_by_token_type` and `attribution_fallback_reason` so we can filter failures.

megan: Perfect. I'll open a small PR for the console tooltip and a tracking ticket for support playbook. cc @tara for the tooltip text.

tara: Thanks — I'll draft a 1-line tooltip and add a help link to the support doc.

devon: Canary applied. Monitoring dashboards: increased `attribution_success` in infra-canary-2 by ~15% after flip. Leaving canary for 2 hours before global rollout.

megan: Great, will follow up with a postmortem blurb and the telemetry queries we used.

sam: Adding the two metrics now. Will ping when they're visible in grafana. :thumbsup:
